data.title: 守岸人 · 与贝壳的对话
data.description: 浅滩上，她蹲下身捡起一枚贝壳举到耳边，认真地听；然后微笑着把它放回原处——她比谁都清楚里面没有海的声音，但仪式感本身值得尊重。

data.promptProse: The Shorekeeper crouches at the shallow water's edge in a white cardigan, blue blouse and long cream skirt. She raises a shell to her ear with serious attention, then smiles and replaces it exactly where she found it. The medium view includes wet sand and the incoming ripple beside her hand. Afternoon light brightens shell ridges and cardigan cuffs, with soft reflected water on the lower face and small contact shadows near the shell.
